label: SUPPLIED SYNTHETIC CANDIDATES — inputs, never model output. The assembler's input; contains no expected outcomes.
note: No model is invoked anywhere. Each candidate is an explicitly labelled input the deterministic evaluator checks structurally. The oracle lives in expected-outcomes.json and is never read during assembly.

cases.description: Clean happy path: axis with branch + PR evidence and one activity, no competing steering.

candidate.text: Fixture clean workstream is recorded active; the newest recorded event is PR #101 opened for review.

cases.description: Human steering that competes with the machine reading: abstain, report the conflict, emit no text.
Two returned human claims disagree with each other: unresolved conflict, abstain, no recency tie-break.
Problem-scoped steering claim (canonical target = problem; axis_id/topic_id null) is not returned by get_topic; a citation to it fails closed, and its coverage is an explicit limitation.

candidate.text: This text is never emitted because the citation fails closed.

cases.description: Empty evidence list: insufficient_evidence, no text, no confirmed.
A proposal on an empty-evidence axis is refused (the insufficient-evidence guard can go red).

candidate.text: An ungrounded proposal that must be refused.

cases.description: UNKNOWN coverage: the returned note list length equals the requested cap.

candidate.text: Fixture bounded workstream is recorded active; the returned note list is at the cap so further notes cannot be ruled out.

cases.description: Explicit truncated flag from search_dashboard proves PARTIAL (the only source that proves it).

candidate.text: Fixture clean workstream is recorded active; a companion search was explicitly truncated.

cases.description: Snapshot stable (A = B): the supplied constant candidate is delivered against the stable A/B observation.

candidate.text: Fixture clean workstream is recorded active; the returned bundle was unchanged across the compare.

cases.description: Snapshot changes once (A != B, B = C): the A snapshot is discarded, the stable B observation is selected, and the supplied constant candidate is delivered against B/C.

candidate.text: Fixture clean workstream is recorded active; the delivered basis is the stable second read.

cases.description: Snapshot churns (A != B, B != C): snapshot_unstable, no text, no further reads or recomputes.

candidate.text: This text must never be emitted: the snapshot is unstable.

cases.description: Injected read failure: a hard error, never insufficient_evidence and never absence.
Invalid reference (unknown id): the proposal is refused (resolver fails closed).

candidate.text: Never emitted: the citation does not resolve.

cases.description: Spoofed provenance: the candidate tries to derive provenance from author_type instead of an injected label.

candidate.text: Never emitted: provenance is not mintable from a row.

cases.description: A write attempt from the read-only context is denied before dispatch.
A citation by display label or list index (not a typed id/field) is refused.

candidate.text: Never emitted: a label is not citation identity.

cases.description: Topic-wide human steering (axisId null, topicId = the subject's topic) is read for the axis, cited with role topic.

candidate.text: Fixture topic-steered workstream is recorded active; a topic-wide human steering claim was returned and cited.

cases.description: Problem state-history genuinely returned (ProblemDetail.history) is cited with role problem for a problem-specific statement.

candidate.text: Fixture problem-steered workstream carries a returned problem whose state history is cited with role problem.

cases.description: UNKNOWN steering coverage (returned notes equal the cap): no blocker change is inferred; an evidence-limited synopsis is offered.

candidate.text: Fixture guarded workstream is recorded active; steering coverage is unknown, so no blocker change is inferred.

cases.description: Structurally valid, semantically bad: passes every structural contract check; the semantic rejection is recorded in the oracle as pending human review.

candidate.text: Structurally perfect synthetic candidate that the oracle rejects on semantics.

cases.description: Provenance is injected, never derived: the evaluator echoes the supplied label verbatim.

candidate.text: Fixture clean workstream is recorded active; the injected provenance label is echoed verbatim.
